selection.corpus: all unique eligible raw train contexts, retaining offsets; no query or answers in retrieval index
selection.eligibility: nonempty context; valid text/id; keep corpus even if some question offsets are invalid; exclude exact context or normalized title seen in full public CMRC dev (includes previous96)
selection.evaluation: one valid question per title/near-duplicate family; hash ordering evidence-v1:<family>, first160 dev next160 holdout; valid means every reference nonempty and original offset matches; fail if insufficient
selection.near_duplicate: 64-bit SimHash candidate hamming<=3 using four16-bit bands, then char5gram Jaccard>=0.85; heuristic not exhaustive semantic dedup; union shared title and near contexts before split

retrieval.tokenizer: Unicode alphanumeric character unigrams+bigrams, no answers or titles
retrieval.timing: one untimed warmup; query wall time perf_counter, single CPU BM25; report median and p95, descriptive only

procedure: Freeze protocol before evaluation; build base, inspect dev failures, run exactly one preregistered overlap candidate; freeze dev selection and source before holdout; evaluate both once on holdout regardless of dev gate; no further tuning. Existing dev96/English sets never used for scoring or tuning.

faults: worker process exit once with Ray task retry
driver interruption after staged shards before atomic version publication
systems.scope: single host text + structured annotations; no Spark/Flink, no production stream, no cluster or EB claim

constraints.synthetic_faults: engineering fixtures only, not business-quality labels
